paragraphs.text: Minsc is a Human Ranger featured in the Dungeons & Dragons cross-over sets Adventures in the Forgotten Realms and Battle for Baldur's Gate .

Minsc is a large, bald man. His face is partially covered in a purple tattoo. He is a kind-hearted — but rather addled — warrior who is known for his habit of talking to his hamster Boo . He believes that Boo is a miniature giant space hamster , but no one else ever saw any evidence of this.
Though depicted on a planeswalker card, Minsc is not a planeswalker within Magic lore.
